item.title: EVER EVASIVE BUBBLE!!! IN NEED OF GREENLIGHT!!!
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: scp article

Genre (Optional): Horror

Elevator Pitch: This scp is a bubble with a folded note inside of it. the outside of the note is a face that looks like it is sleeping. the scp seeming to subconsciously avoid all forms of touching. Inside of the folded note may be a memetic symbol, a ground breaking discovery, or a piece of information so horrible, it could shatter even the most sturdy minds.

Central Narrative: This scp was found in a circus that came to [REDACTED] Wisconsin one in a while. A researcher was taking his kids to that circus one day and there was a sign that read ,"EVER-ELUSIVE BUBBLE!!! COME TRY TO POP IT!" the researcher, thinking it would be a great first circus game for them to try, took them into the tent. The kids jumped at the bubble, trying to pop it, and each time, the bubble unnaturally evaded the attempt. The research had called his site director and told him about it. Later after the circus closed, an MTF squad circled the perimeter and closed the circus down. The reason they told the local police and the circus members was because of "safety" and "Drug use". The circus is now a private site of the foundation. several cameras and MTF members have been placed around the perimeter. A monitor room has been placed just outside of the site to keep track of the property.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The note inside of the bubble could have anything in it.
